content: xcap 0.9.8 (Aug 2026, still maintained, March 2026 macOS Spaces commit) is the pragmatic screenshot crate already integrated; screencapturekit-rs 11 is the modern ScreenCaptureKit alternative but needs macOS 13+ plus a Swift-bridge build and only pays off for HDR/streaming needs. Keep xcap 0.9, build interval + window-change + hotkey triggers around it.
